description: Publish an illustrated report for the team, shown on the project page: plates (one per thing you built or fixed) with a title, a role line, a status chip, figures (project images by asset path, e.g. reports/rigs/stag.jpg, uploaded first with inventor_snapshot or assets push), a tag line (e.g. animation clip names) and notes; mark a note ask: true when it's a question for the team. Same slug updates the report. Reports stay team-only; a person decides whether to publish one. Pass only slug to read one, nothing to list them.
